title: Five Queries Are Enough: Query-Efficient and Surrogate-Free Membership Inference Attacks on RAG via Entailment
authors: Nguyen Linh Bao Nguyen; Wanlun Ma; Viet Vo; Alsharif Abuadbba; Minghong Fang; Jun Zhang; Yang Xiang
why_relevant: Proposes a membership inference attack against RAG, which is a privacy attack on the retrieval corpus rather than a robustness/reliability issue from unreliable evidence.
why_not_or_caveat: Privacy-focused MIA is tangential to the survey's focus on noise, distraction, conflict, poisoning of evidence, and calibration.
